expectations.text: Scope: all ePHI the organisation creates, receives, maintains, or transmits — across all systems, locations, and media, based on an asset/data inventory
expectations.evidence: "Scope: every system, application, and location where ePHI is created, received, maintained, or transmitted... Data flow mapping... You can't assess risk to data you haven't located"

expectations.text: Process: identify threats and vulnerabilities, assess current safeguards, and rate likelihood and impact to derive risk levels
expectations.evidence: "Threat and vulnerability identification specific to your environment... Current control assessment: what safeguards are actually in place today... Likelihood and impact analysis... a documented risk level (e.g., high/medium/low)"

expectations.text: Documentation and maintenance: the analysis must be documented and periodically reviewed/updated (after incidents, new systems, organisational change)
expectations.evidence: "OCR guidance explicitly calls for periodic review/updates — after any material change (new systems, EHR migration, cloud move) and generally at least annually" plus documented outputs

expectations.text: Distinguishes a true risk analysis from a compliance checklist or gap assessment — a vendor checklist alone does not satisfy 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(A)
expectations.evidence: "A filled-in checklist is not a HIPAA-compliant security risk analysis... a generic yes/no checklist almost never meets it" against 45 CFR §164.308(a)(1)(ii)(A)

expectations.text: Notes that a missing/inadequate risk analysis is OCR's most-cited failure in ransomware-related enforcement (Risk Analysis Initiative; 2026 self-funded plan settlements)
expectations.evidence: Says "one of the single most frequently cited failures in OCR resolution agreements" but never mentions ransomware enforcement, the Risk Analysis Initiative, or the 2026 self-funded plan settlements
